relations: Celia；Roland Loiseau（Beatrice 的爱人，鬼魂）；Beatrice（已故，卡的听众）；Ida（誓言转述者）
numbers: 纸页保持贝壳形「一个世纪」；浴室木雕四景（那喀索斯）

facts.fact: 抱湿纸团从鹿径跛回档案馆（你的家），倒进罩篷浴缸；老管出褐水
facts.anchor: I stumbled up the stairs and spilled myself into your hooded bathtub.
facts.verbatim: I stumbled up the stairs and spilled myself into your hooded bathtub.

facts.fact: 冷水冲洗福尔马林：阴冷潮湿里长着致命未知之物
facts.anchor: deadly, unknown things grew in the cold and damp
facts.verbatim: deadly, unknown things grew in the cold and damp

facts.fact: 热水龙头自己飞转、水压翻倍；暖息拂颈——「不常见你在这里，宝贝儿」
facts.anchor: I’m not used to seeing you in here, precious
facts.verbatim: I’m not used to seeing you in here, precious

facts.fact: 龙头光泽里高瘦人影、手绘和服宽袖；他叹「这是我们在我们房子里最喜欢的地方」
facts.anchor: This is my favorite place in our house.
facts.verbatim: This is my favorite place in our house.

facts.fact: 镜前解腰带、法语唱走调歌：「你工作太拼命，总是刮擦着写」——Roland Loiseau
facts.anchor: The voice of your lover curled around me like the steam of the bath.
facts.verbatim: The voice of your lover curled around me like the steam of the bath.

facts.fact: 浴室是他的礼物：那喀索斯四景浴缸，注定毁灭的致命美
facts.anchor: four scenes from the myth of Narcissus
facts.verbatim: four scenes from the myth of Narcissus

facts.fact: 你的最后一个故事本是为他写；悲恸中弃稿；Ida 发誓不毁也不给；你死后全校翻找未获唯一草稿
facts.anchor: never found your only draft of Dreams of the Rose
facts.verbatim: never found your only draft of Dreams of the Rose

facts.fact: 冰唇擦耳「感到孤单吗」——她尖叫挥击，独自一人；血脚印旁纸团卷回贝壳形
facts.anchor: curled back up like a shell
facts.verbatim: curled back up like a shell
